title: How to stream Shakira's Madrid concert, exclusively with Amazon Music
summary: Shakira's October 3 Madrid performance as part of her 'Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran' world tour will stream live exclusively via Amazon.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Shakira's first full concert global livestream airs October 3 on Prime Video, Amazon Music, and Twitch, no subscription required.


- Beyond the livestream, the global celebration of Shakira will see the release of a new remix, vinyl record, and more.


- Shakira, AWS, and Laboratoria aim to provide 1 million women with free AI and cloud training by 2028.


---


Shakira is bringing her Madrid concert to fans around the world exclusively via Amazon with


[Amazon Music Presents: Shakira Live From Madrid .](https://music.amazon.com/live/events/LZA73A728V)


[Amazon Music](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/amazon-music) and Shakira have announced that her performance from the final stop of her


[Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran](https://music.amazon.com/albums/B0CVQK6CRG?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_2RXQEgZykKLIxI12N8tLIxeJG) world tour at her ES Latina European Residency in Madrid will air live globally on Saturday, October 3, marking her first full concert global livestream.


[What is ‘Amazon Music Live’? Here’s everything you need to know.](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/amazon-music-live)


The fifth season of 'Amazon Music Live' hits the road with performances on tour from Noah Kahan, Don Toliver, Lainey Wilson, and Doja Cat.


## How to watch Shakira’s livestream concert via Amazon Music and Prime Video


Fans across the world can watch the concert live on Saturday, October 3 beginning at the following times:


- 11:45 AM PT / 2:45 PM ET (U.S.)


- 12:45 PM (Mexico City)


- 3:45 PM BRT (Brazil)


- 7:45 PM BST (UK)


- 8:45 PM CEST (Madrid, France, Germany, Italy)


- 12:15 AM IST (India, October 4)


The livestream will be available on the


[Amazon Music app](https://www.amazon.com/music/amazon-music-app) ,


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) , the Amazon Music app on


[Fire TV](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/fire-tv) , and the


[Amazon Music channel](https://www.twitch.tv/amazonmusicde) on


[Twitch](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/twitch) . No subscription is required.


## What is the ‘Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran’ world tour?


The Madrid residency is the final chapter of Shakira’s


Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran


world tour, which brings music born from a deeply personal period of resilience and reinvention.


Women around the world have made its message their own, adding another chapter to Shakira’s three-decade career crossing languages, genres, and borders.


Shakira’s music continues to connect with listeners today. On Amazon Music,


[Dai Dai](https://music.amazon.com/tracks/B0H1FPCMRF?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_wzBXu2Zv8z93mqIShcHqKFyDY) is the No. 1 song worldwide in 2026 year to date, and Shakira is the most-listened-to Latina artist worldwide over the same period.


“The


Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran


world tour has become more than I could ever have imagined, and I am so proud of it. I’m so excited to take it even further by sharing this special evening with fans around the world, together with Amazon Music,” said Shakira.


[Everything to know about Audible](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-to-know-about-audible)


Audible, a premium audio storytelling service, offers membership plans designed for different listening styles, as well as more than a million titles including audiobooks, podcasts, and Audible Originals.


## Shakira and Amazon Music are collaborating to support women


The livestream is the centerpiece of


The Women Shaping Latin Music


, the 2026 edition of


Music Connects Us


, the annual Amazon Music celebration of the artists, sounds, and cultural movements shaping Latin music.


This year, the program honors the women who paved the way, celebrates those moving music forward today, and creates opportunities for those who come next.


Shakira’s Madrid performance brings the story to a global stage, while the following new initiatives in education and commerce carry it beyond the concert.


[Las Mujeres Facturan Con Amazon Music.](https://www.amazon.com/gp/browse.html?rw_useCurrentProtocol=1&node=222165681011&tag=linkfiregen&ie=UTF8&linkCode=as2&ascsubtag=0fd201fe7453574ec8b19ffa4241e7d4&ref=dmm_acq_soc_gb_u_lfire_lp_x_0fd201fe7453574ec8b19ffa4241e7d4)


Inspired by the lyric


“


las mujeres ya no lloran, las mujeres facturan


”


(“women don’t cry, they cash in”), the Las Mujeres Facturan Con Amazon Music storefront on Amazon.com helps women entrepreneurs bring their businesses to more customers. It is a shopping destination featuring products from women-owned businesses, with a spotlight on Latina-owned brands, alongside merchandise and physical music from female Latin artists, connecting with customers worldwide. The storefront also features a dedicated space that lets customers meet the women behind the brands in their own words.


Las Mujeres Ayudan Con Amazon Music.


This builds on Shakira’s longstanding commitment to education through her nonprofit, Fundación Pies Descalzos. Together with


[Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://www.aboutamazon.com/amazon-aws-news) and women-in-tech nonprofit Laboratoria, the foundation is launching


[AWS Entrena Latinas](http://latinas.awsentrena.com/) , an initiative expanding access to technology skills across Latin America through free training in cloud computing and AI, entirely in Spanish. The program’s goal is to reach 1 million women by 2028, driving toward 50% female participation in a field where women hold only 26% of tech roles. Starting in Colombia, students and mothers connected to Fundación Pies Descalzos will be able to take foundational courses and pursue AWS AI certifications, helping them prepare for new career opportunities in technology.


[How to watch ‘Drawn Together,’ the adaptation of ‘Marfil’ by Mercedes Ron, streaming now on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/marfil-drawn-together-prime-video)


Starring Ester Expósito and Hugo Diego García, the first part of the 'Enfrentados' duology is streaming exclusively on Prime Video.


## More ways to experience Shakira with Amazon Music


The celebration continues with several new releases for fans to enjoy:


- [New Amazon Music Original remix.](https://music.amazon.com/albums/B0HKQ2PRQT)


RVSSIAN has produced the


Dai Dai Spanish Remix


(Amazon Music Original)


.


- [Amazon exclusive vinyl.](https://a.co/d/0ed3h55b) Shop the Amazon exclusive orange and yellow marble vinyl edition of


Laundry Service


, celebrating the album’s 25


th anniversary, available only at Amazon.


- [El Mixtape.](https://music.amazon.com/playlists/B0HJSNC76Y?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_XM08OLpU6BDmYJWrylV91C8C0) Personally curated by Shakira, this brings together music from the women artists who have shaped her.


- [\[Re\]Discover Shakira .](https://music.amazon.com/playlists/B08BLC47G6?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_alu8mqQQT2CzJFEHPSXxH7AFh) Revisit the songs that defined her rise.


- [On Tour.](https://music.amazon.com/playlists/B0HJHCXCPM?marketplaceId=ATVPDKIKX0DER&musicTerritory=US&ref=dm_sh_DzyerbfHAPwyW0aNnPPurZLQc)


Celebrate music from the last chapter of her global tour.


## What is El Museo Shakira by Amazon Music?


Shakira’s ES Latina European Residency in Madrid serves as the onsite expression of the global celebration.


At its center is interactive exhibit El Museo Shakira by Amazon Music, guided by


[Alexa+](https://www.aboutamazon.com/what-we-do/devices-services/alexa-plus) , the next generation of Alexa. Fans visiting the museum can move through spaces that trace Shakira's journey across her milestones in music, fashion, culture, and social impact.


An all-women Amazon Music stage reimagines some of her biggest songs live, celebrating the women shaping Latin music today.


The Las Mujeres Facturan Con Amazon Music and Las Mujeres Ayudan Con Amazon Music initiatives will also extend onsite at the festival through dedicated experiences, including a space showcasing local Latina-owned businesses and AWS Entrena Latinas, bringing the celebration’s social impact initiatives directly to fans.
